original_ai_output.title_zh: 警方在纳萨拉瓦州森林展开针对匪徒和绑架者的突袭行动
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 纳萨拉瓦州警察局已启动特别行动，旨在清剿藏匿于全州森林中的匪徒、绑架者、武装抢劫者及其他犯罪分子。州警察局长谢蒂马·穆罕默德周三在拉菲亚宣布行动启动，随后警力进入多马地方政府区的阿拉杰森林。据其表示，此次行动是执行警察总监奥拉通吉·迪苏的指令，以加强安全并恢复持久和平。

location.raw_text: Alagye Forest in the Doma Local Government Area of Nasarawa State

key_facts.fact: 纳萨拉瓦州警察局启动特别行动清剿森林中的匪徒和绑架者
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Nasarawa State Police Command has commenced a special operation to flush out bandits, kidnappers, armed robbers and other criminals staying in forests across the state.

key_facts.fact: 州警察局长谢蒂马·穆罕默德周三在拉菲亚宣布行动启动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The state Commissioner of Police, CP Shetima Mohammed, flagged off the operation on Wednesday in Lafia

key_facts.fact: 行动是执行警察总监奥拉通吉·迪苏的指令
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the exercise was in compliance with the directive of the Inspector General of Police, Olatunji Disu, to enhance security and restore lasting peace in the state

key_facts.fact: 战术小队、反绑架单位和情报人员已部署至热点地区和森林走廊
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: tactical squads, anti-kidnapping units and intelligence operatives had been deployed to identified flashpoints and forest corridors

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
行动成效及是否抓获嫌疑人尚未证实
